tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background, sticky header and sticky search bar. Also the browser theme-color.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, lists, match cards, tables, inputs, tab bar, bottom sheet.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body text on bg and surface. The toast inverts it (text as background, bg as ink).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: meta lines, labels, table headers, inactive tabs. 4.8:1 on bg (light), 6.9:1 (dark).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: 1px borders on cards and rows, empty progress track, default pill background, knocked-down cup outline.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: THE brand orange: primary buttons, links, active tab, 'mine' highlights, ★ VOI badge, group badges, progress fill, 'Tocca a voi' banner, referee score, focus rings. Overloaded — see The roast.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Text on accent fills. Light theme is only 4.3:1 (fails AA for the 16px button label).

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tint for 'mine' rows, checked choices, the staff/team header pill, step focus halo. accent on it is 3.6:1 (light) — fails for the header pill text.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Champion banner fill, warm-banner border. Never text on surface (2.2:1).

tokens.name: beer
tokens.usage: Standing cups, TV-board clock and points, bracket winners, 3rd-place qualifier stripe on the board. Same value in both themes; nearly the same as gold (two names for one colour).

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Winners, 'Pagato ✓' / 'Presente' pills, qualifier stripe, and the referee's ▶ Inizia / ✓ Conferma buttons (white label: 4.4:1 light, 1.75:1 dark — fails badly). On ok-soft only 3.7:1 (light).

tokens.name: ok-soft
tokens.usage: Success flash and ok pill background.

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: Warning pills ('Non pagato', 'da completare') and the 'Preparatevi' banner. There is no warn ink: warnings use text.

tokens.name: err
tokens.usage: Error flash, danger button, the referee's ✗ Fuori button and the LIVE pill (white on it: 2.3:1 in dark), the last-30-seconds clock.

tokens.name: err-soft
tokens.usage: Error flash background.

tokens.name: t1
tokens.usage: Live page: team 1 (blue) name, odds bar and trend. The old shooter buttons that used it as a fill are gone (crowd reporting was removed), but their CSS remains.

tokens.name: t1-soft
tokens.usage: Declared for team 1 tints; unused by any rule.

tokens.name: t2
tokens.usage: Live page: team 2 (red). Visually collides with err and the LIVE pill.

tokens.name: t2-soft
tokens.usage: Declared for team 2 tints; unused, and identical to err-soft in dark.

tokens.name: board-bg
tokens.usage: TV/projector board page background (hard-coded on body.board, forced dark in both themes).

tokens.name: board-surface
tokens.usage: Board cards (group tables, bracket cells).

tokens.name: board-line
tokens.usage: Board borders and row rules.

tokens.name: board-muted
tokens.usage: Board secondary text.

tokens.name: board-text
tokens.usage: Board primary text.

tokens.name: board-qualify
tokens.usage: Hard-coded qualifier stripe on the board's group tables; a third green that is neither ok light nor ok dark.

tokens.name: cup-ink
tokens.usage: Cup numbers on beer-coloured cups (5.6:1).

tokens.name: cup-highlight
tokens.usage: Highlight stop of the standing-cup radial gradient.

tokens.name: voucher
tokens.usage: First-beer voucher fill (hard-coded). White on it is 2.5:1.

tokens.name: voucher-edge
tokens.usage: Dashed border of the first-beer voucher.

tokens.name: heat-1
tokens.usage: Heatmap ramp step 1 (fewest hits). The ramp reverses in dark so low values recede.

tokens.name: heat-2
tokens.usage: Heatmap ramp step 2.

tokens.name: heat-3
tokens.usage: Heatmap ramp step 3.

tokens.name: heat-4
tokens.usage: Heatmap ramp step 4 (midpoint, same in both themes).

tokens.name: heat-5
tokens.usage: Heatmap ramp step 5.

tokens.name: heat-6
tokens.usage: Heatmap ramp step 6.

tokens.name: heat-7
tokens.usage: Heatmap ramp step 7 (most hits).

tokens.name: heat-ink-low
tokens.usage: Numbers on heat-1…heat-4.

tokens.name: heat-ink-high
tokens.usage: Numbers on heat-5…heat-7.

tokens.name: heat-zero
tokens.usage: Cup never hit (dashed outline).

styles.name: board-title
styles.usage: TV board title; clamp(1.6rem, 3.2vw, 3rem) in code, shown at its max.

styles.name: stat-big
styles.usage: Counters in stats rows (presenti / iscritte / mancano). Tabular numerals.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Banner headline: where to go, who won.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Si parte appena ci sono tutti.
styles.usage: Default. Inputs are pinned to 16px so iOS never zooms.

styles.name: team-name
styles.usage: Team names in match cards and lists.

styles.name: tab-label
styles.usage: Bottom tab bar labels (11.2px — small for a bar).

styles.name: clock
styles.usage: Live match countdown; turns err and pulses in the last 30 s.

styles.name: feed-time
styles.usage: Timestamps in the live shot feed.

spacing.note: There is no spacing scale in the code: gaps and paddings use a dozen or more values between 2 and 32px. These are the steps that recur most.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Rack cup gaps, pill rows.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Default gap between buttons, cards in a stack, grid gaps.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row padding, list gap, card padding between stacked labels.

tokens.name: space-card
tokens.usage: Card / list row / match card inner padding — off any 4px grid.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Page gutter, banner padding, bottom-sheet padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section breaks, footer gap.

radius.note: Thirteen distinct radii in the stylesheet (4, 6, 8, 9, 10, 12, 14, 16, 18, 20, 22px and 50% / 999px). A tighter set (8 / 14 / pill) would read the same.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, feed items, mini result rows.

tokens.name: radius-choice
tokens.usage: Radio choices, segmented control, shooter buttons, toast, group-letter tiles on the board.

tokens.name: radius
tokens.usage: The main token (--radius): cards, lists, banners, tables, flash.

tokens.name: radius-ref
tokens.usage: The referee's big ▶ Inizia / ✓ Conferma buttons.

tokens.name: radius-arena
tokens.usage: Live arena panel, board group cards.

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheet top corners.

tokens.name: radius-hero
tokens.usage: Board champion banner.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pills, LIVE badge, header 'me' pill, progress bars, jump chips.

tokens.name: tabbar-h
tokens.usage: Bottom tab bar height (plus the safe-area inset).

tokens.name: touch-min
tokens.usage: Minimum button height; small buttons drop to 38px.

tokens.name: input-min
tokens.usage: Minimum input height; wide primary buttons are 54px, stepper buttons 64px.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max width of main: the app is phone-only by design.

tokens.name: cup-sm
tokens.usage: Cups in the read-only arena racks.

tokens.name: ref-go-h
tokens.usage: Height of the referee's primary buttons: sized for a wet table.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheet lift. The only real shadow in the system.

tokens.name: stripe-mine
tokens.usage: Left stripe on your own match card. Inset box-shadow is used as a stripe for mine / qualifier / feed side.

tokens.name: halo-now
tokens.usage: Halo around the current step of the tournament progress.
